title: tracy_demo check runs in the background on tracy-web and dsh polls its result, so a check longer than the edge's ~100 s still reaches the agent and is counted once
steps: S1: a client-send demo build, planned and ready: check.start while the vision look is held open, a second check.start, check.status, then let the look finish and poll check.status; close the action and read check.status and call check.start; write a running clientCheck from another process started long ago and read check.status.

S2: runDemoLifecycle {operation:'check'} against a send that answers check.start running then a result; against an older tracy-web (AGENT_DEMO_BAD_OPERATION); with a refusal or a result from start; still running past the 10-minute bound; with Stop; with failed status polls on the way.
expect: S1: start answers running at once with one checkId; the second start joins it; status is running and nothing is counted yet; after the look finishes status carries pass:false and the looks-finished check under the same checkId, counted exactly once; after the action closes status still answers that checkId and check.start is AGENT_DEMO_ACTION_CLOSED; the silent check is DEMO_CHECK_LOST and not counted.

S2: sends check.start then check.status until the result; falls back to one synchronous check; answers start's refusal or result without polling; DEMO_CHECK_RUNNING with running:true; TURN_STOPPED after one send; two failed polls are ridden through, six in a row are the answer, DEMO_CHECK_LOST is the answer at once.
fence: check.start/check.status: background check with heartbeat in wo_build.qa.clientCheck, counted when saved, readable after the action closes; dsh polling with fallback only on AGENT_DEMO_BAD_OPERATION
evidence: dev 24/10/2026: every tracy_demo check answered Cloudflare 524; the action stayed queued/fill

tests: client-send reserves real chat and one native user request before provision
check starts the server check and polls its status in short calls until it has a result
check against a tracy-web without check.start falls back to the one long check call
check answers a refusal or a finished result from start at once, never polling
check still running at the wait bound says so; Stop ends polling without another send
check polls through a few failed status calls on the way, then answers the last failure
